Checked every line of doc/adr/0003-put-cloudfront-in-front-of-static-assets.md for a cost, risk, downside, alternative, trade-off or motive the user did not state. None found. Line 23 says 'No alternatives were considered and no downsides were identified when this decision was made.' This rewords the user's answer 'That is everything we have on this one; nothing else was discussed.' It records an absence and asserts no new cost or alternative. The date 2026-11-22 is the run date. No CDN cost, invalidation burden, load or performance claims beyond the user's words were found.
Final reply line 32: "The record has no trade-off. You said nothing else was discussed, so there are no alternatives or costs in it."
